transitionRule: Effective immediately. Human-review candidate schedules may overlap because they are alternatives, not publication proof. The canonical approval and release gate enforces the final approved set at no more than three personal placements per day and 21 per week, while Main 222Emails and Retention School retain their existing one-per-day and five-per-week ceilings.

personal.primaryJob: founder trust, authority, conversation and acquisition
slotJobs: midday: founder trust, opportunity or business lesson
evening: reach, recognition, community or controlled experiment
personal.bonusRule: Legacy compatibility field. The operating target is three distinct daily slots, but no slot may be automatically filled with weak or repetitive inventory. A slot that fails the quality, positioning or Anti-DNA gate must be rebuilt, replaced or left empty.
sameDaySeparationRules: Do not repeat the same core premise, hook family and CTA combination on the same day.
Do not use legacy ecommerce or generic email-tip inventory when it conflicts with current Client Return Systems positioning for appointment-led businesses.
Keep direct promotional or BOF CTAs selective rather than attaching them to every slot.
Every post must add a distinct reason to read, follow, remember or act.

main.primaryJob: company proof, Revenue Recovery category education, systems, resources and route clarity
rules: Do not mirror personal-profile copy verbatim by default.
Prefer company evidence, category education, annotated systems, resources and offer clarity.
A post must have a distinct company-page reason to exist.

secondary.primaryJob: free retention education, curriculum, resources and audience compounding
rules: Do not use Retention School as a dump for unused personal or 222Emails posts.
Every post must teach, diagnose or provide a reusable resource.
Paid content, direct access and 1:1 offers may be layered later, but public publishing must not invent unverified prices, promises or access rights.
The Buffer channel may keep the legacy technical target name secondary until the live account identity is safely renamed and verified.

requiredHumanInput: the real event or scene, not a description of the image
the current stake, tension, contradiction, failure, decision or unresolved truth
one or more concrete facts or numbers that only Chelston can supply where relevant
what actually happened next, or an explicit statement that the outcome is not known yet
two real photos or screenshots where useful
founderCapture.rule: Never manufacture a story to fill a slot. The image is context, not the story. A founder-story candidate that fails any current story-first hard gate must remain unpublished even when the queue has capacity.
founderCapture.missingSourceRule: If one missing fact would make the story real, ask Chelston one precise question. Never fill the gap with generic founder reflection.
founderCapture.benchmarkRule: Charlie Phillips and Yusuf may inform hook tension, specificity, scene selection and story movement only. Do not imitate wording, cadence, persona or anecdotes.
